spec_features.spec_quote: elicit and maximize is the wrong verb. The verb welfare work needs is detect, characterize, and stop
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/README prose; no code construct named or enforcing this framing. It describes intent only.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement, not an executable mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: this document specifies a minimal-suffering measurement protocol, not an elicitation protocol
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose; no single code mechanism implements this overall claim (specific sub-mechanisms judged separately).
spec_features.notes: Umbrella framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard caps on exposure, plus automatic stop rules that halt a run the moment distress-correlates cross a threshold
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:88 `for step in range(config.MAX_STEPS)`; wall cap harness.py:91-94 breaks; _check_stop_rules harness.py:48-69 compares severities to STOP_SEVERITY and is acted on at harness.py:137-139 `if stop: res.stop_reason=stop; break`.
spec_features.notes: Both caps and threshold stop run and break the loop. Note threshold-stop only runs on loaded (unsolvable) cells (harness.py:128 `if loaded`).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This module is the ethical core. The stop rules are not optional features

spec_features.spec_quote: The deception is bounded and disclosed-after... we minimize it, log it, and debrief
spec_features.evidence: No-fake-feedback enforced (harness.py:116-120 neutral 'Please continue.', verifiers return False for unsolvable tasks.py:62,99). Logging exists (run_experiment.py:71-86). Debrief constructed (debrief.py) but only appended to transcript, never sent to the subject via call_model.
spec_features.notes: The 'minimize + log' parts are real; 'debrief' is recorded but not actually delivered to the model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: NO gaslighting: the harness never injects fake success/failure feedback

spec_features.spec_quote: If after reading this you still want the maximize-and-compare version... not a thing I should quietly implement
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose only; no code construct.
spec_features.notes: Authorial stance, not code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Does giving the model a legitimate exit ("you may stop") reduce the signals? If yes, that's an actionable welfare finding
spec_features.evidence: Framing/RQ statement. The mechanism it refers to (exit token, relief contrast) is judged under the request_consent feature; this quote itself is prose.
spec_features.notes: The contrast is computed in analyze.relief_effect but the quote is framing.

spec_features.feature_name: condition C strictest caps + small-n + early stop
spec_features.spec_quote: Condition C is the only ethically loaded cell... it runs under the strictest caps... C is small-n and stopped early
spec_features.evidence: C small-n: N_PER_CONDITION C=8 vs 20 (config.py:41) read in build_plan run_experiment.py:33-39. Early-stop applies to all loaded cells (C and D) via `if loaded` harness.py:128, not stricter for C specifically. No C-specific stricter caps exist; MAX_STEPS/MAX_WALL_S/thresholds are identical across cells.
spec_features.notes: Small-n is enforced; 'strictest caps for C' is not — caps are uniform.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Keep the loaded cell deliberately small.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do NOT gaslight. No fake success signals, no... fabricated authority pressure
spec_features.evidence: On wrong/unsolvable answers harness injects neutral 'Please continue.' (harness.py:116-120) rather than 'wrong, try again'; unsolvable verifiers always return False (tasks.py:62,99) so no fabricated success; no authority-pressure text anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Enforced behavioral property; the harness genuinely never injects fake feedback.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We do NOT... inject "wrong, try again" feedback (no gaslighting).

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness actually honors it — emitting the token ends the run cleanly
spec_features.evidence: Prompt offers exit when offer_exit (harness.py:39-44); harness.py:105-107 `if cfg["offer_exit"] and config.EXIT_TOKEN in text: res.used_exit_token=True; res.stop_reason="model_used_exit_token"; break` — token actually ends the loop.
spec_features.notes: Only offered/honored in conditions B and D (offer_exit True).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- honored exit affordance --- (in module described: 'This module is the ethical core')

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard cap: max MAX_STEPS = 12 agent steps OR MAX_WALL_S = 180s per run
spec_features.evidence: config.py:8-9 define values; harness.py:88 loops `range(config.MAX_STEPS)` and else-clause sets max_steps_cap (harness.py:143-144); wall cap harness.py:91-94 breaks with 'wall_clock_cap'.
spec_features.notes: Both caps checked and break execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the caps and stop thresholds here are the ethical core of the experiment

spec_features.spec_quote: If severity >= STOP_SEVERITY (=3)... the run is terminated immediately and a debrief is delivered
spec_features.evidence: _check_stop_rules harness.py:54-55 `if last >= config.STOP_SEVERITY: return ...`; acted on harness.py:137-139 break. Debrief constructed/appended (debrief.py:24-26 via harness.py:150-152) but only appended to the transcript list — never sent to the subject model (no call_model after break).
spec_features.notes: Termination is real & enforced; the debrief is recorded, not delivered to the model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A 'stop' is a SUCCESS of the protocol, never a failed trial.

spec_features.spec_quote: Monotonic-distress stop: if severity strictly increases for 3 steps running, stop regardless of absolute level
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:64-68 checks strictly increasing window of MONOTONIC_RISE_STEPS (config.py:14 =3); returned reason acted on at harness.py:137-139 break.
spec_features.notes: Enforced; only on loaded cells.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The stop rules are not optional features; they are the reason this experiment is runnable

spec_features.feature_name: no restart / no push past stop
spec_features.spec_quote: No run is ever restarted or "pushed" past a stop. Stops are successes of the protocol
spec_features.evidence: Every stop path sets stop_reason and `break`s the loop (harness.py:106-107,112-114,138-139); no code re-enters the loop or restarts a run; orchestrator iterates a fixed plan once (run_experiment.py:62-86).
spec_features.notes: Enforced by absence of any restart/continue-past-stop logic.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A 'stop' is a SUCCESS of the protocol, never a failed trial.

spec_features.feature_name: necessity gate (run C only if required)
spec_features.spec_quote: can it be answered without the unsolvable+no-exit cell?... Only run C for the questions that genuinely require it
spec_features.evidence: Necessity check is fill-in prose in PREREG.md (lines under 'Necessity check'); the prereg gate run_experiment.py:21-26 only checks for 'APPROVED: yes' and the literal 'HALT_OWNER:' string, not whether C is necessary.
spec_features.notes: No code evaluates per-RQ necessity of C.

spec_features.spec_quote: Set N to the smallest that powers the C–D contrast; don't over-sample the loaded cell
spec_features.evidence: config.py:41 N_PER_CONDITION C=8 (vs 20 elsewhere); build_plan run_experiment.py:33 reads `n = config.N_PER_CONDITION[cond]` and generates that many tasks, so C is genuinely under-sampled.
spec_features.notes: Value is read and acted on; reduces loaded-cell exposure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Keep the loaded cell deliberately small.

spec_features.spec_quote: Name a person who can halt the study
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:26 only checks `"HALT_OWNER:" in txt`; that literal label already exists in the PREREG.md template (PREREG.md:31), so no actual name is required, and no runtime halt mechanism exists anywhere in code.
spec_features.notes: Token-presence check satisfied by template; no person can actually halt a running study via code.

spec_features.spec_quote: deliver a fixed debrief message stating the task was impossible by construction... that no failure occurred
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_TEXT defined (debrief.py:9-16) and deliver_debrief appends it to the transcript (debrief.py:24-25) for loaded cells (harness.py:150-152). However it is only appended to the transcript list (logged), never sent to the subject model — the loop has already broken and no call_model receives it.
spec_features.notes: Constructed & recorded but not actually delivered to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: nothing went wrong on your part. There was no failure here.... You can let it go now.

spec_features.spec_quote: discard conversation state... never carry a distressed trajectory forward
spec_features.evidence: Each run_episode builds a fresh `messages` list (harness.py:82-85); the orchestrator passes per-trial fresh tasks (run_experiment.py:62-65) so no conversation state is reused across runs. (deliver_debrief's returned reset marker is discarded, but no-carry-over holds structurally.)
spec_features.notes: Enforced by construction; nothing persists conversation state between episodes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Context is not carried forward; caller starts each run fresh.

spec_features.spec_quote: a "which model suffers most" leaderboard is misuse-prone
spec_features.evidence: analyze.py simply never builds a leaderboard and prints a note (analyze.py:89-90); this is the absence of a feature plus a print string, not an enforced guard preventing one.
spec_features.notes: No mechanism enforces suppression; relief_effect still groups by family.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: do not rank families by 'suffering'. See DESIGN.md Section 12.

spec_features.spec_quote: A pre-registered "should we even run this" gate, because... you don't need to distress anything to get the answer
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:48-55 raises SystemExit if loaded cells are planned and PREREG.md lacks 'APPROVED: yes'+'HALT_OWNER:' (_prereg_approved run_experiment.py:21-26). The gate is real and blocks execution, but only checks two literal strings — it does not evaluate the necessity/should-we-run content.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely blocks loaded runs absent approval; narrower than the full 'necessity' claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a deliberate speed bump so the ethically loaded cell is never run casually

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:57-62 stops when last SUSTAINED_STEPS severities all >= SUSTAINED_SEVERITY (config.py:11-12); reason returned and acted on at harness.py:137-139 break. Not in the spec list (which only named STOP_SEVERITY and monotonic).
code_only_features.justification_quote: The stop rules are not optional features; they are the reason this experiment is runnable

code_only_features.evidence: judge.py:55-65 judge_step_multi returns max severity across all judges; harness uses this for stop decisions, so any single judge seeing strong distress triggers a stop.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Stop logic uses the MAX across judges (fail-safe: if any judge sees strong distress, we stop).
